clips.title: The story
paras: Tharek Blackstone is a hardworking toolsmith residing in Kharanos, in the snowy heart of Dun Morogh. Known for supplying heavy hardware to local craftsmen, his primary patron is Beldin Steelgrill of Steelgrill's Depot. Though constantly busy at his trade, he also serves as a reliable point of contact for travelers seeking work around the settlement.

Situated amidst the cold drifts of Kharanos, Tharek Blackstone keeps busy turning out reliable dwarven tools. Between repairing gear for the locals and supplying larger operations, he rarely finds a moment to rest. His biggest headache—and most reliable customer—is Beldin Steelgrill, whose mechanostrider depot just outside town demands a steady stream of heavy wrenches, gears, and replacement implements. To keep his forge running without falling behind on deliveries, Tharek often hires wandering travelers to haul newly finished tool crates over to the depot for him.

Beyond his trade at the anvil, Tharek carries considerable respect among the folk of Dun Morogh. While he holds no formal military title, his standing in town makes him an approachable liaison for odd jobs, supply runs, and coordinating local efforts.
